paper.title_en: Recent Developments in Colibri: A Neural-Network PDF Model and Improved Bayesian Sampling
paper.abstract_en: We present recent developments in Colibri, an open-source framework for flexible fits of parton distribution functions (PDFs). Colibri allows the implementation of any PDF functional form as well as Bayesian, Monte Carlo, and Hessian inference methods, making it particularly well suited for systematic comparisons of model architectures and uncertainty propagation treatments. In these proceedings, we report on two key updates to the framework: the release of colibri-n3fit, an open-source implementation of the neural-network model used by the NNPDF collaboration, and the integration of an upgraded, highly efficient Bayesian sampler, bridging the gap between the computational cost of Bayesian PDF fitting and other uncertainty propagation treatments. Combined, these updates extend Colibri's capabilities to neural-network PDF fits, enabling direct, quantitative Bayesian analyses of the n3fit architecture and opening new avenues for comparative studies.
